entities.summary: The Saru Taqi Mosque is a Shi'ite mosque located in the bazaar, near the Hassan Abad Gate, in Esfahan, in the province of Isfahan, Iran. The mosque was completed in 1053 AH (1643/1644 CE), during the Safavid era.
